description:
Position: Senior ​Salesforce Developer/Expert 
 Interview Process: Phone & Skype 
 ​Notes from Hiring Manager: 
 
 Communication skills… 9.5-10… do not have to be “native speakers” but must have sophisticated communication skills. 
 In depth knowledge of Salesforce and SF Best Practices. 
 Used to doing end to end projects on small teams where they are a primary developer/Salesforce expert. If they have been on large teams, they need to be SF experts and do end to end development. 
 
 · Knowledge of advanced OO patterns, architecture principles and database design
 · Packaging and deployment for major and minor releases
 
 
 · Experienced with Java, C#, C++, .NET or other related languages, and experience with developing enterprise applications
 · Skilled at analyzing, troubleshooting and solving problems
 · Strong understanding of relational database design
 · Salesforce.com certified Developer DEV401


 Richard
 631-649-1313 Ext- 723
